title: billing-profile.json — Discover phase billing artifact
description: Cost breakdown derived from a GCP billing export CSV. Produced by the discover-billing fragment (full path: Steps 0-4; lightweight path: the _extract_billing.py script). Provides service-level spend and AI-signal detection from billing data alone. This is the FLOOR contract (required structure only; additional properties allowed) so a legitimately richer profile never trips a false gate. The lightweight extraction path emits a subset (metadata/commitments/cost_basis may be absent); this schema's required set is therefore the intersection both paths must satisfy. Field VALUES and how to derive them are the discover-billing prose; this schema is the shape + per-field meaning.

metadata.description: Provenance of the billing data. Present on the full path; may be omitted on the lightweight extraction path.

project_directory.description: Absolute path to the analyzed project.

billing_source.description: The billing export file the profile was derived from.

billing_period.description: The billing month the export covers (YYYY-MM).

total_monthly_spend.description: Total monthly GCP spend from the billing export (at list price when available).

service_count.description: Number of distinct GCP services with charges.

services.description: Per-service spend, sorted descending by monthly_cost. Only services with cost > 0 are included.

gcp_service_type.description: Terraform resource type equivalent for the service (e.g. google_cloud_run_service); used by downstream phases to correlate billing with IaC.

monthly_cost.description: Monthly cost for this service (at list price; excludes commitment fee rows).

top_skus.description: Highest-cost line items within the service (excludes commitment fee SKUs).

sku_description.description: SKU line-item description from the billing export.

monthly_cost.description: Monthly cost of this SKU line item.

ai_signals.description: AI-related keywords found in this service's SKU descriptions (e.g. vertex_ai, generative_ai). Empty array when none.

commitments.description: Committed-use discount (CUD) detection. Full path only.

has_active_cuds.description: Whether any CUD commitment fees or credits were detected.

total_monthly_commitment_fees.description: Sum of commitment fee line items (positive values).

total_monthly_cud_credits.description: Sum of CUD credits applied (negative values).

effective_discount_percent.description: Overall discount rate from all commitments.

region.description: Region the commitment is scoped to.

cost_basis.description: List-vs-net price accounting. Full path only.

uses_list_price.description: Whether costAtListUSD was available and used as the baseline.

total_at_list.description: Total spend at list price (before discounts).

total_net_of_discounts.description: Total spend after all discounts applied.

ai_signals.description: Project-level AI detection derived from billing SKU analysis.

detected.description: Whether any AI/ML services were found in the billing data.

confidence.description: Confidence that the project uses AI (0..1), derived from billing SKU analysis.

services.description: List of AI-related GCP services found.

Generative AI - Gemini Pro Input Tokens
